title: Replicating the AI Transparency Atlas scoring on a held-out set of model/system cards

original_idea.body: Replicating the AI Transparency Atlas scoring on a held-out set of model/system cards

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Replication supports credible audits but as a direct replication the chain to catastrophic-risk reduction has a gap.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Apply published rubric to new cards with LLM judge; beginner-accessible.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Tightly scoped replication on a held-out set with sensitivity check.

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Independent replication has value but largely reuses an existing pipeline.

novelty.reasoning: Direct replication of a published scoring method.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Direct replication of an existing transparency-scoring pipeline.
